verdict.rationale: RevenueCat's REST API and secret API keys allow scripting operations like refunds and granting promotional entitlements, and server-side migration explicitly supports sending 'all of the Apple receipts and/or purchase tokens' in one import, which implies some bulk-processing capability. However, there is no explicit bulk/batch endpoint, no documented multi-item update API, and the MCP/AI Toolkit docs describe single-entity management (products, entitlements) rather than bulk operations across many items. missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API endpoints, explicit documentation of AI-driven multi-item operations, independent evidence of bulk usage at scale.
